
Fats and Oils: Oilseed Crushings, Production, Consumption 
and Stocks

ISSN: 2379-9862

Released November 2, 2026, by the National Agricultural Statistics Service 
(NASS), Agricultural Statistics Board, United States Department of 
Agriculture (USDA).

Highlights

August 2026 contained 31 days.
Sep
Soybeans crushed for crude oil was 5.96 million tons (199 million bushels) in 
September 2026, compared with 
6.29 million tons (210 million bushels) in August 2026 and 6.15 million tons 
(205 million bushels) in September 2025. Crude oil produced was 2.31 billion 
pounds, down 6 percent from August 2026 and down 4 percent from September 
2025. Soybean once refined oil production at 1.91 billion pounds during 
September 2026 decreased 5 percent from August 2026 and decreased 2 percent 
from September 2025.

Canola seeds crushed for crude oil was 238,790 tons in September 2026, 
compared with 229,809 tons in 
August 2026 and 230,362 tons in September 2025. Canola crude oil produced was 
182 million pounds, up less than 1 percent from August 2026 but down 4 percent from 
September 2025. Canola once refined oil production, at 172 million pounds 
during September 2026, was down 2 percent fro
